privacy.ai_training_note: Five9's Global Data Processing Addendum (Section 4.4) explicitly prohibits Five9 from retaining, using, or disclosing Personal Information 'outside of Customer's instructions...or for any commercial purpose not specified in the Agreement.' The public Privacy Policy states it does not cover Customer Personal Information; that is governed by the customer agreement. No public statement explicitly says 'we do not train on your data' but the DPA contractual restriction is the operative protection. The trust center lists AI governance resources including 'AI Training Data and Bias' and 'AI Governance' sections. Custom redaction policies are available via AI Trust and Governance tooling.
privacy.data_region: US primary headquarters. EU/UK transfers handled via 2021 Standard Contractual Clauses (controller-to-processor Module 2) and UK Addendum. Sub-processor list maintained at login.five9.com. Global DPA does not specify geographic region-lock options; customers receive 30-day notice of new sub-processors handling EEA/UK data.

security.name: Penetration Testing
security.value: Annual third-party penetration testing confirmed; Five9 deploys stateful inspection firewalls, DMZs, intrusion prevention and detection systems (IPS/IDS), two-factor authentication, VPN, and vulnerability scanning.

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP)
security.value: Managed via Bugcrowd (support@bugcrowd.com). Disclosure-only program: 'Please be aware that this program has no monetary awards.' Prior written approval required for authorized testing at cybersecurity@five9.com. Safe harbor provided under CFAA and DMCA.

security.name: SLA and Uptime
security.value: Five9 VCC Platform SLA = 99.999%. Actual average monthly availability last 12 months: 99.997%. 24x7x365 Network Operations Center and Security Operations Center.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Encryption in transit via HTTPS, sFTP, sRTP, VPN. Encryption at rest for recordings and transcripts. Data partitioning in multi-tenant infrastructure.

security.name: Data Centers
security.value: AICPA AT 101/SSAE 18 audited data centers. Two-factor building access, 24/7 on-site security, real-time intrusion detection/prevention.

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Role-based access, principle of least privilege, audit logs, data integrity controls, NIST SP 800-53 rev5 password standards, PCI DSS login-attempt controls.

security.name: Bi-Annual Trust Reviews
security.value: Enterprise customers get bi-annual meetings with top technology executives covering infrastructure changes, system upgrades, and platform enhancements.

security.name: AI Security (AI Trust and Governance)
security.value: Dedicated AI Trust and Governance product: granular guardrails, LLM observability, hallucination monitoring, prompt injection detection, custom redaction policies.

products.name: Inbound Contact Center
products.data_scope: Full contact center data including customer calls, recordings, transcripts, PII, and call metadata. HIPAA and PCI DSS scope depending on industry use.
products.notes: ACD, IVR, skills-based routing, omnichannel (voice, chat, email, SMS, social). Subject to full HIPAA/PCI scope.

products.name: Outbound Contact Center
products.data_scope: Customer PII, dialing lists, campaign data, call recordings. PCI DSS in scope for payment campaigns.
products.notes: Predictive, progressive, and preview dialing. STIR/SHAKEN compliance for US outbound calls.

products.name: Blended Contact Center
products.data_scope: Combined inbound and outbound scope. Same HIPAA/PCI DSS considerations.
products.notes: Unified inbound and outbound queue management.

products.name: Workforce Engagement Management (WEM)
products.data_scope: Agent recordings, screen captures, performance data, QM evaluations. Recording data protection features available.
products.notes: Quality Management, Workforce Management, coaching, scheduling. Dedicated WEM Recording Data Protection data sheet published.

products.name: Five9 Genius AI Suite (Agent Assist, GenAI Studio, Voice AI Agents)
products.data_scope: Real-time conversation data processed by AI models; customer and agent utterances may be processed by third-party LLMs. Custom redaction policies available.
products.notes: Includes Agent Assist, IVA, GenAI Studio, and autonomous Voice AI Agents. AI Trust and Governance module provides guardrails, hallucination monitoring, and prompt injection detection. Check DPA and model provider sub-processors for LLM data flows.

products.name: Five9 AI Trust and Governance
products.data_scope: Monitoring layer over AI interactions; performance metrics, threat detection logs.
products.notes: Granular guardrail configuration, LLM observability dashboards, prompt injection detection. Separate product add-on.

compare.pricing_model: Per-seat subscription (monthly). Entry plans from ~$119/seat/month (Digital) and ~$159/seat/month (Core). Plus/Pro/Enterprise tiers require custom quote (typically $200-$300+/seat/month). 50-seat minimum for all plans. Annual contracts standard.
compare.data_residency: Cloud-only (AWS/GCP infrastructure). US-primary. EU/UK data transfers via 2021 SCCs and UK Addendum. No published region-lock or single-tenant option in public documentation.

flags: VDP via Bugcrowd is disclosure-only with no monetary rewards; limited financial incentive for external researchers.
AI training policy is contractually restricted in the DPA (Section 4.4) but not stated as a plain-language public commitment; enterprise buyers should request explicit AI data-use addendum.
Data residency: no published option for region-locked or single-tenant deployment; EU/UK transfers rely on SCCs.
FedRAMP authorization not held; GovRAMP membership only. US federal agency deployments require independent verification.
50-seat minimum makes Five9 unsuitable for SMBs; enterprise-only positioning.
HIPAA compliance is Type 1 Attestation (design assessment), not Type 2 (operating effectiveness over time). Buyers should verify BAA availability.
